scope: Read-only targeted source and JSON review; no training, checkpoint load, reference integration, other-review reading or 488-file artifact rehash. Current source inspected; no inference that current source generated every historical run.
han_count_method: Body sections 1-6; count U+4E00-U+9FFF; exclude table rows, image links and caption lines starting figure/table number. Top-level numbered section headings are excluded; subsection headings and non-caption prose are included. Section quota baselines were not independently supplied.
math_check: Substitute a=1/C^2, b=s, c=y^2/4 and multiply by exp(y/C); obtains exp(-y*sqrt(s))/(sqrt(s)*(sqrt(s)+1/C)) for Re(s)>0 and C>0.
